title: Ukraine updates: Key bridges in Kyiv, Crimea hit in strikes
summary: Kyiv's mayor said Russian forces have hit bridges on the Dnipro River. Ukraine launched a massive attack on Russia earlier on Monday, hitting the Crimean Bridge. DW has the latest.

image.caption: Russian strikes damaged bridges over the Dnipro in early October too, seen here [FILE: October 2, 2026]Image: State Emergency Service of Ukraine/REUTERS

blocks.text: Crimea strike kills 2, says Russia-installed governor
A drone strike on Crimea has killed two people, according to the Russia-installed governor Sergei Aksyonov.
He said on Telegram that the strike took place in the Leninsky district of Crimea, which was seized and annexed from Ukraine in 2014.
Earlier Aksyonov said that Ukraine had struck the Kerch bridge, causing traffic to be suspended.
Moscow built the Kerch Bridge to link the annexed Crimean Peninsula to the Russian region of Krasnodar Krai in the northern Caucasus.
The route is a major source of supplies for Russian forces in Ukraine's occupied Kherson region and is a strategically significant target for Ukrainian forces.
